notes.title: Legion Playtest #2
notes.content:
[p]The second round of Steam Playtests as begun![/p][p][/p][p]Several improvements have been made server-side to make the game faster and better![/p][p][/p][p][b]All game modes[/b] (Practice, Casual and Ranked) are open for the duration of the playtets, as well as all accompanying features. The duration of this Playtest is [b]undetermined[/b]: we'll keep it open as long as we get feedback and find improvements to make![/p][p][/p][p]All progress you made will be saved for future playtests, demos and final release. Moreover, all attendees to the playtest will be eligible for 🔥 [b]unique powerful items [/b]when the game launches![/p][p][/p][p]Players will be allowed in by batches to spread out the feedback, but be sure that every one will be accepted into the playtest![/p][p][/p][p]Expect bugs, issues, crashes, your cat catching on fire, that's the reality of the very first playtest. All your feedback will be religiously studied and help make Legion the most kickass game you ever played!

All feedback can be shared in this [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3729580/discussions/0/595155000272111640/?snr=2___"]thread[/url] or in our Discord![/p]

notes.title: Legion Playtest #1
notes.content:
[p]The first round of Steam Playtests as begun! [/p][p][/p][p]Fire up your Steam client and sign up for the first exclusive playtest to experience your first taste of Legion and let us know anything that doesn't go well! [/p][p][/p][p][b]All game modes[/b] (Practice, Casual and Ranked) will be open for the duration of the playtets, which will last for a few days, and all accompanying features will also be available.[/p][p][/p][p]All progress you made will be saved for future playtests, demos and final release. Moreover, all attendees to the playtest will be eligible for 🔥 [b]unique powerful items [/b] when the game launches![/p][p][/p][p]Players will be allowed in by batches of 5 to spread out the feedback, but be sure that every one will be accepted into the playtest![/p][p][/p][p]Expect bugs, issues, crashes, your cat catching on fire, that's the reality of the very first playtest. All your feedback will be religiously studied and help make Legion the most kickass game you ever played!

All feedback can be shared in this [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3729580/discussions/0/595155000272111640/"]thread[/url] or in our Discord![/p]
